info.title: STEG Smart Internship & Administrative Platform API
info.description: REST API specifications for STEG intern lifecycle, administrative workflows, and finance validation.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Upload, download, and metadata of documents; CV/supporting files attached to applications and internships

tags.name: Finance
tags.description: Endpoints for Finance Cases, dossier review, payment decisions and receipts

tags.name: Companion
tags.description: Endpoints for Tasks, Journal Entries, and Deliverables

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: Endpoints for Journal Entry, Deliverable, and Evaluation comments

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description: Endpoints for internship certificate generation and download

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Registration, login, token refresh, and logout endpoints

tags.name: AI Assistance
tags.description: Endpoints for advisory AI analysis, candidate Q&A, and recommendation review

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: Conversations, messages, delivery/read receipts, attachments (REST fallback to the STOMP real-time channel)

tags.name: Organization
tags.description: Department and employee management — ADMIN / HR only

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: State machine for internship application and internship lifecycle transitions

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Read-only Back Office audit trail viewer (ADMIN only)

tags.name: Evaluations
tags.description: Endpoints for Internship Evaluations, Scores, and Task Reviews

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Read-only Back Office reporting dashboards (aggregate queries only)

tags.name: Evaluation Templates
tags.description: Endpoints for managing Evaluation Templates and Criteria (HR/ADMIN)

InternshipUpdateDatesRequest.description: Payload to update internship dates, automatically triggering deterministic reclassification

observationObligatoire.description: Explicit flag for observation internship: true for OBLIGATOIRE, false for OPTIONAL.

EmployeeRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating an employee

departmentId.description: UUID of the department this employee belongs to

userId.description: UUID of the linked user account (optional)

DepartmentRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a department

code.description: Unique short code for the department

name.description: Full display name of the department

parentDepartmentId.description: UUID of the parent department for hierarchical structure
Parent department UUID, null if top-level

CandidateRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a candidate profile

skills.description: Comma-separated or freetext list of skills

nationalId.description: National ID / CIN — stored encrypted, never returned in list endpoints

CandidateDetailResponse.description: Full candidate profile including sensitive fields (only for self or staff)

nationalId.description: National ID (CIN) — decrypted, only shown to self or staff

ApplicationUpdateRequest.description: Payload for updating mutable fields of a DRAFT application

status.description: Current status in the lifecycle state machine

submissionDate.description: Date the application was formally submitted

calculatedType.description: Calculated internship type (set by business logic)

InternshipAssignmentRequest.description: Payload to assign or reassign an internship to a Department and Supervisor

InternshipCreateManualRequest.description: Payload to manually register an internship directly for a candidate

observationObligatoire.description: Explicit flag for observation internship: true for OBLIGATOIRE, false for OPTIONAL. If null, conservatively defaults to OPTIONAL.

observationObligatoire.description: Explicit flag for observation internship: true for OBLIGATOIRE, false for OPTIONAL. If null, conservatively defaults to OPTIONAL.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token obtained during login

ApplicationCreateRequest.description: Payload for creating a new internship application (creates in DRAFT status)
